name: test_new_gate.py
mathematical_scope: Eight tests cover zero-upper positive controls, GF17 candidate counts, polynomial scaling/minors, factor/resultant metadata, sampled independent SymPy resultants, slice roots and a W-leading-coefficient dimension witness.
input_and_guard_coverage: Fixed seeds and primes; symbolic-resultant samples explicitly skip degree drops. Does not authenticate imported dependencies or fully compare saved coefficient exports.
costs: setUpClass builds sparse factors/resultants; enumeration O(p^4) at p=17 and many sparse evaluations, plus external SymPy. No version pins.
test_evidence: Strong aspects: independent SymPy determinant algorithm, selected bad/zero-column controls, fixed exact witnesses. Weak aspect: L39–41 checks saved term counts only; exported coefficient tampering preserving counts is invisible. exact_nonzero_resultants.json is never read.
acceptance_boundary: Tests are evidence for intended algorithm paths, not exact artifact acceptance. Dimension argument requires nonzero linear W2 and a leading coefficient invertible at the reduction prime as well as the mod17 nondivisibility witness.
findings: L39–41 can pass a saved export with altered coefficients and unchanged term counts. L69 skips all degree-drop specializations. L80–87 alone does not verify the entire divisibility/base-locus argument.
